findings.title: Ops/METRICS_TOKEN compared non-constant-time and has no rotation path
evidence: server.ts:2011 if (configured && token === configured) return true;
No METRICS_TOKEN entry in docs/runbooks or the secret-rotation runbook
findings.impact: A static, never-rotated ops credential with a byte-comparison side-channel; compromise requires rotation but no procedure exists.
findings.recommendation: Use crypto.timingSafeEqual over equal-length buffers and document METRICS_TOKEN rotation alongside the other host secrets.

report: Security core is sound: JWKS JWT verification with role claims, detached owner-signature verification for the launch gate (config.ts:285-306), Origin allowlist with Vary (server.ts:1328-1364), dependency-aware readiness, and non-root read-only containers. Residual: the /metrics and ops bearer token are compared with `===` (non-constant-time) and the token has no rotation path (server.ts:1286, 2011; config.ts:231).
